queEsAthx.ogTitle: What is ATHX: athlete guide for 2027
queEsAthx.ogDescription: What ATHX is, competition format, categories, and how to prepare.
queEsAthx.title: What is ATHX and how to prepare for ATHX 2027
queEsAthx.intro: ATHX is the functional fitness competition we train our athletes for. This guide explains the format, categories (ATHX and ATHX PRO), and how to build an ATHX programming plan that gets you to the podium.

format.title: The ATHX format
format.body: ATHX combines three blocks: Strength, Endurance, and MetCon X. Each block measures a different capacity and is scored independently. The winner is who performs most balanced across all three.

programming.title: What serious ATHX programming looks like
programming.body1: Well-designed ATHX programming periodizes into 4 phases: BASE, BUILD, PEAK, and DELOAD. Load increases progressively by RPE and % 1RM, with unload weeks to arrive fresh at competition.
programming.body2: ATHX training must include the year's movements from week 1 — if you arrive at competition with questionable technique, you won't compensate with volume.

q1.question: What is ATHX?
q1.answer: ATHX is an international functional fitness competition, held across different cities. It brings together strength tests, endurance events, and mixed competitions (MetCon X). ATHLEX Training doesn't organize the competition: we train athletes who want to compete in it with specific programming.

q2.question: What are the ATHX events?
q2.answer: ATHX is divided into three blocks: Strength (max strength), Endurance (endurance), and MetCon X (mixed events with weighted and gymnastics movements). The cycle culminates in a simulation of all 3 blocks.

q3.question: Difference between ATHX and ATHX PRO?
q3.answer: ATHX is the open category. ATHX PRO increases volume and intensity for competitive athletes: longer sessions, higher loads, and stricter movement standards.

q4.question: How do I prepare for ATHX?
q4.answer: With sport-specific ATHX programming: periodization in BASE, BUILD, PEAK, and DELOAD, calibrated by RPE and % 1RM. ATHLEX Training delivers a weekly plan Monday through Sunday, warm-up, strength and MetCon each day, plus direct chat with coach.

q5.question: When is ATHX 2027?
q5.answer: Official ATHX 2027 dates are announced on the competition's official channels. Our programming is aligned to the competition calendar.

movements2027.pageDescription: Reference guide to ATHX™ movements and technical standards: Strength, Endurance and MetCon X. Get ready with ATHLEX Training.
movements2027.ogDescription: What counts as a valid rep in each ATHX™ movement, zone by zone.
movements2027.title: The movements you'll see in 2027
movements2027.intro: A zone-by-zone reference: what counts as a valid rep, what equipment is allowed, and how each block is scored. Based on the most recent known rulebook — always check ATHX™'s official rules.

zones.title: Max strength
zones.blurb: Three lifts, three attempts at a valid rep. This is where the base work pays off.
zones.equipmentNote: Allowed: chalk, knee sleeves, elbow sleeves, belt, weightlifting shoes. Not allowed: straps, grips, knee/elbow wraps.

movements.name: Strict Press
standards: Bar starts on the rack in front rack.
Valid rep: bar overhead with hips and knees extended.
Any dip, jerk, or leg bounce voids the rep.
Bar returns to the rack when finished.

movements.name: Back Squat
standards: Bar in back rack, full extension at the start of each rep.
Hip crease below the knee on every descent.
Valid rep on standing up to full extension.
Dropping or throwing the bar voids the score.

movements.name: Deadlift
standards: Every rep starts on the floor, hands outside the knees.
Free grip: pronated, mixed, or hook.
Valid rep with hips and knees extended, no bounce.
Max pause between reps: 5 seconds.

zones.title: Endurance
zones.blurb: Run and row combined against the clock. Whoever covers the most distance wins.

movements.name: Run
standards: Discipline switch every 750 m (ATHX™) or 1000 m (PRO).
At minute 22 the current lap is finished and the clock stops.
Scored on total distance covered, not time.

movements.name: Row
standards: Free damper setting, adjustable before and during.
Same discipline-switch pattern as the run.
The meter counter doesn't reset between switches.

zones.title: Mixed
zones.blurb: Six movements, one circuit. This is where real competition-pattern training shows.
zones.equipmentNote: Shoes mandatory, one pair of knee sleeves max. No grips, no headphones.

movements.name: Ski-Erg
standards: Full calories completed before releasing the handles.
Releasing the handle in a way that causes damage draws a 30s penalty.

movements.name: Ground to Overhead
standards: ATHX™: single dumbbell, snatch or clean & jerk, alternating arms after each valid rep.
PRO: both dumbbells at once from the floor.
Valid rep with hips, knees, and arms extended over the body's centerline.

movements.name: Sandbag Carry
standards: 30 m course (there and back).
If dropped, pick it up and restart from the line.
Any carry method is valid.

movements.name: Box Jump Overs
standards: Two-foot takeoff required, both feet land on the box.
Free descent: jump down or step down.
Jump only in the lane's direction.

movements.name: Burpee Broad Jumps
standards: Chest touches the floor on every rep.
Broad jump with simultaneous two-foot takeoff and landing.
Hands land within 33 cm of the feet for the next burpee.

movements.name: Walking Lunges
standards: ATHX™: dumbbells in a suitcase hold at the sides.
PRO: dumbbells in front rack.
Back knee touches the floor on every step, no shuffle steps.
